title: [main]- Bug 647007 Copy Document on a Purchase Credit Memo 'Quantity Received', and 'Quantity Invoiced' reverted back on original Purchase Order
summary: Posting a purchase credit memo created with Copy Document from a posted invoice no longer reverts the received and invoiced quantities on the original purchase order. GetPurchaseInvoiceLine now skips the Order No./Order Line No. fallback for inventory item lines without a linked item ledger entry.
key_points: The Purchase Cr. Memo Line table gains logic to detect whether a credit memo is corrective or merely copied
Posting a copied credit memo no longer reverts the source purchase order line quantities
Corrective credit memos with item ledger entry links continue to work as designed
Added test cases to verify quantities remain correct after posting copied credit memos
The fix applies across all localization layers (W1, NA, BE, ES, FI, GB, IT, NO, RU, SE, APAC)
